title: Hata mimi niliye Mjapani hupotea kwenye Kituo cha Shinjuku
label: Kituo cha Shinjuku

text.This is some trivia about Shinjuku Stati: Haya hapa mambo machache ya kuvutia kuhusu Kituo cha Shinjuku.
text.World's Busiest: Kituo chenye shughuli nyingi zaidi duniani
text.Maybe it is the station with the most us: Labda ndicho kituo chenye wasafiri wengi zaidi nchini Japani?
text.Shinjuku Station is not just the busiest: Kituo cha Shinjuku si kituo chenye shughuli nyingi zaidi nchini Japani tu, bali duniani kote.
text.If you add JR, private railways, and the: Ukiunganisha JR, reli za binafsi na treni ya chini ya ardhi, karibu watu milioni 3.5 hupanda na kushuka kila siku.
text.It is also in the Guinness World Records: Pia kiko katika Rekodi za Dunia za Guinness kama “kituo chenye shughuli nyingi zaidi duniani.”
text.The fun trivia about Shinjuku Station is: Jambo la kufurahisha kuhusu Kituo cha Shinjuku ni kwamba ni kikubwa mno na kina utata mwingi.
text.When you go to Shinjuku Station for the: Ukienda Kituo cha Shinjuku kwa mara ya kwanza, bila shaka utapotea.
text.Even I, a Japanese person, get very lost: Hata mimi nikiwa Mjapani hupotea sana huko.
text.If you ask which map app is the most rel: Ukiuliza programu gani ya ramani inayoaminika zaidi Japani, huenda jibu likawa Google Maps.
text.It is the map app Japanese people use th: Ndiyo programu ya ramani inayotumiwa zaidi na Wajapani na hutoa taarifa sahihi sana kuhusu Japani.
text.But even with Google Maps, Shinjuku Stat: Lakini hata ukiwa na Google Maps, Kituo cha Shinjuku ni kigumu kuelewa.
text.It is long, the buildings are tall, and: Kituo ni kirefu, majengo ni marefu, na sehemu nyingine ziko chini ya ardhi.
text.So you really do not know where the pin: Kwa hiyo hujui kabisa pini ya ramani iko wapi.
text.That is the hard part, but also the fun: Hiyo ndiyo sehemu ngumu, lakini pia ya kufurahisha.
text.What I remember from TikTok is that Shin: Ninachokumbuka kutoka TikTok ni kwamba Kituo cha Shinjuku kina milango mingi sana ya kutoka na kina utata kiasi kwamba hata wafanyakazi rasmi hawawezi kuihesabu.
text.It seems that Shinjuku Station has exits: Inaonekana Kituo cha Shinjuku kina milango ya kutoka katika sehemu nyingi sana.
text.(I had AI look this part up too.): (Niliomba AI itafute maelezo ya sehemu hii pia.)
text.Depending on how you count, the answers: Kulingana na namna ya kuhesabu, majibu yalitofautiana sana: “takriban 80,” “zaidi ya 100,” au “takriban 200.”
text.It seems it changes depending on whether: Inaonekana idadi hubadilika kutegemea kama milango ya maeneo ya maduka ya chini ya ardhi imejumuishwa.
text.\"Nobody can count them\" does not seem: Kauli “hakuna anayeweza kuihesabu” haionekani kuwa ya uongo.
